review_rule: A contract is accepted only when row_count and rows_sha256 match the exact audited path/class/function/text inventory. New or changed rows return the whole contract to unresolved review.

advanced_brush_product_integration_contr.evidence: The 55 exact rows define Tiger's deterministic advanced-dab product model: unit mask intersection with zero-strength neutral identity, replay-seeded noise/texture fields, scale-and-offset sampling over the ordered dab sequence, one-dimensional wet-edge pooling, normalized percentage inputs, and uint64 seed normalization. app.painter_brush_dynamics.dynamic_dabs calls advanced_dab_alphas, whose provenance-aware AST call graph reaches all four primitives only through app.painter_advanced_brush; unrelated imports, local shadows, arbitrary methods, comments, strings, and import-only references are rejected. DrawingCanvas._paint_stroke uses this path for live, committed, PNG, and video-QImage rendering. Tests prove disabled byte identity, zero-strength identity, corrupt/oversized seed replay, Protect Texture document-setting precedence including scale response, malformed nested setting normalization, actual rendered-pixel change, identical replay, Undo/Redo, and document payload restoration. Rendering leaves authored brush_dynamics unchanged; the same calculation-only workload planner exposes bounded-degrade diagnostics through Painter Action state. This is an explicit Tiger-authored product policy and makes no physical wet-media or Adobe/Corel brush-engine parity claim.

color_input_widget_geometry_contract.evidence: Exact frozen geometry rows for the Painter color-wheel triangle radius rule and Photoshop-style SV field QRectF bounds. tests/test_painter_color_input_geometry.py dispatches real floating-point QMouseEvent presses through the widgets immediately inside the wheel hue/white/black vertices and at its centroid, plus all four SV corners, an outside clamp point, and the hue strip; it also retains forward/inverse quantization checks at minimum and normal/resized extents. A forced logical-size subclass reaches the field's 8-DIP structural floor. Separate QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1 and =2 processes prove DPR changes while logical triangle/field geometry and an actual bottom-right SV event result remain identical. The wheel rule subtracts 24 times its authored scale; the field uses one-DIP top/left margins, a two-DIP vertical reserve, a 24-DIP horizontal reserve, and an 8-DIP floor. These are Tiger layout/input policies, not Adobe color-picker parity. Sources: https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6/PySide6/QtGui/QMouseEvent.html and https://doc.qt.io/qtforpython-6/overviews/qtdoc-highdpi.html.

capacity_declared_authored_archive_resou.evidence: 16 MiB document JSON and 512 MiB asset limits are declared Tiger zip-bomb/memory guards, not OpenRaster/ZIP format limits. Boundary and traversal tests cover rejection. PNG writer zlib level is excluded and routed as its own exact encoding-policy contract.

capacity_declared_authored_atomic_action.evidence: 512 strokes and 2,048 source points bound one atomic Action/Undo payload only. They do not limit document stroke count; namespace schema, adapter validation, and boundary tests share these constants.

capacity_declared_authored_blockout_prev.evidence: One-unit blockout checker floor tile default for a non-physical preview helper; it is not artwork resolution or a measurement claim.

capacity_declared_authored_reference_stu.evidence: Reference-study region/stroke budgets bound a diagnostic planner and cannot certify similarity, artistic quality, or document capacity.

capacity_declared_bounded_pbr_preview_re.evidence: 512 px defaults bound optional PBR preview-map generation only. Static material export uses document/output dimensions and is audited separately.

capacity_declared_bounded_preview_resolu.evidence: 768 px wet-canvas display preview ceiling; committed layer state and export are not downscaled by this value.

capacity_declared_painter_zoom_product_c.evidence: 800% is the same explicit Tiger view-zoom capacity in CPU UI and GPU capability reporting. It changes view scale only, never document pixels or export resolution.

capacity_serialized_recovery_writer_conc.evidence: One recovery worker serializes atomic snapshot writes and is exposed in runtime telemetry. Recovery tests verify ordering/error state; this is not a throughput claim.

capacity_declared_authored_dynamic_dab_w.evidence: 8,192 materialized dabs per stroke is a measured Tiger runtime workload guard, not a document, brush-format, quality, or third-party parity limit. The uncapped 256x256 40-segment worst-case probe estimated 228,304 dabs and approximately 111.7 MB peak in independent QA. The guarded implementation uniformly resamples the complete path to 8,192 dabs, preserves both endpoints and every segment in that probe, and reports requested/effective spacing plus estimated/rendered counts and degraded=true. Corrected-source measurement recorded 24.9963 ms median untraced generation, 55.6207 ms median QImage render, and 4,427,871-byte traced peak. Independent 16K/5,000-point QA also stayed at 8,192 dabs with about 4.78 MB traced peak. These target-machine observations justify bounded materialization only; they are not a universal frame-time guarantee.

capacity_declared_authored_action_stroke.evidence: The 8 samples-per-segment and 512 generated-point defaults are Tiger-authored Action-path policies, not tablet behavior, document capacity, or external brush parity. smooth_action_points now requires integer controls, rejects non-finite point channels, preserves every normalized source control in order even when input count exceeds 512, distributes only the remaining budget across the complete path, and preserves caller budgets above the former 2,048 hidden cap. tests/test_painter_stylus.py verifies exact 512-point default allocation for 100 controls, exact preservation of 700 controls, a 2,300 caller budget, signed-channel interpolation, and rejection of fractional controls; tests/test_painter_actions.py verifies non-finite channel rejection at the Action boundary.

capacity_declared_authored_resource_poli.evidence_required: Correct bounded worker errors and OpenGL session lifetime, then freeze budgets only after corrected-source repeated long soak and context-loss tests.

capacity_declared_shared_large_canvas_ti.evidence: The remaining exact row enforces a positive runtime tile extent at the retained OpenGL compositor boundary. The shared policy is configurable from 32 through 1,024 pixels with 256 as the Tiger default, not a GPU, Qt, image-format, or universal performance limit. painter_canvas_gpu_capabilities now reports the default and supported range instead of falsely presenting 256 as fixed. tests/test_painter_large_canvas.py::test_shared_tile_policy_reaches_caches_gpu_compositor_capabilities_and_telemetry configures 64 pixels and proves the same value reaches all four retained CPU caches, the GPU compositor call, and telemetry while capability metadata remains aligned with the shared constants. Existing context-loss, cache-completeness, dirty-tile, and CPU-fallback tests cover recreation/failure behavior without claiming universal resource safety.
